portada.texto: 300 professional prompts for the food & beverage industry
For chefs, managers, pastry chefs, bakers, bartenders, chocolatiers,
sommeliers, restaurant owners, caterers, food truckers and every professional in the industry.

bienvenida.texto: Welcome to the Gastro Pro Prompts eBook

This eBook contains 300 professional prompts ready to use in AI Chef Pro. A well-built prompt multiplies the value of any AI tool. Here you will find prompts organized into 3 strategic blocks, designed to cover every situation you face in the day-to-day of the food & beverage industry.
10 categories × 14 prompts: Creative Cooking; Management, Costs & Waste; Catering; Digital Marketing; Pastry; Food Pairing; Allergens; Business Management; Leadership & Teams; Deep Research.
10 profiles × 10 prompts. Executive Chef, Manager, Pastry Chef, Baker, Bartender, Sommelier, Chocolatier, Owner/Entrepreneur, Catering Chef, Food & Beverage Consultant.

7 business types + specialized agents in the suite: Independent Restaurant; Casual Restaurant & Bistro; Hotel & Hotel Food Service; Ghost Kitchen / Delivery; Pastry Shop & Production Kitchen; Bar & Cocktails; Food Truck; plus Specialized Agents.

1. Find your category, profile or business type in its block (see the structure above). 2. Copy the prompt straight into the matching agent in AI Chef Pro. 3. Replace the fields in [BRACKETS] with your own information. 4. Experiment: adjust the tone, extend the request or combine prompts. 5. Save your best results — they are assets of your business.

cierre.texto: Thank you for choosing AI Chef Pro!
You now hold 300 tools to transform your food & beverage work.
The only limit is your curiosity.

bloques.intro: 10 major thematic categories covering every area of professional culinary and food & beverage work. Each category includes 14 ready-to-use prompts.
10 professional profiles from the food & beverage industry. Each profile includes 10 prompts designed specifically for the challenges and responsibilities of that role.
Prompts specific to each type of food & beverage business and to the specialized agents in the AI Chef Pro suite. Designed for the concrete situations of each business model.

secciones.encabezado: 13. Specialized Agents: Vision of the Future

prompts.titulo: Signature Recipe with a Local Ingredient
prompts.cuerpo: Act as a high-end chef with 15 years of experience in product-driven cuisine. I want to develop a signature recipe using [LOCAL INGREDIENT/STAR INGREDIENT]. The dish must reflect [CULINARY PHILOSOPHY: seasonal/hyperlocal/avant-garde]. Include: the story of the dish, ingredients with exact quantities for 4 servings, step-by-step preparation, suggested plating and a recommended pairing.

You are a creative chef specialized in avant-garde cuisine. Take the classic dish [CLASSIC DISH NAME] and reinterpret it with modern techniques. Keep the essence of the original flavor but transform the texture, presentation and cooking technique. Give me 3 different versions: a minimalist one, a deconstructed one and one with a cultural fusion [CULTURE].

Design a 7-course tasting menu for a [TYPE/CONCEPT] restaurant. Each dish must have narrative coherence, as if telling a culinary story about [THEME: a journey, a season, a memory]. For each course include: a poetic dish name, main ingredients, key technique and estimated kitchen prep time.

Act as a chef specialized in sustainable, zero-waste cooking. I have these whole ingredients available: [LIST OF INGREDIENTS]. Create a signature recipe that uses 100% of each ingredient, including the parts that are normally discarded (skins, seeds, stems, bones). Explain which part of each ingredient is used and for which preparation.

prompts.titulo: Recipe Built Around a Specific Technique
prompts.cuerpo: I'm a chef and I want to master the technique of [TECHNIQUE: spherification/gelification/emulsification/fermentation/cold smoking]. Design a complete recipe that has this technique as its star. Include: a scientific explanation of the technique, ingredients with exact weights (grams or ounces), step-by-step process with critical temperatures and times, common mistakes to avoid and how to present it on the menu.

prompts.titulo: Cultural Fusion with a Scientific Basis
prompts.cuerpo: Combine [CULTURE 1] cuisine with [CULTURE 2] cuisine to create a fusion dish that makes culinary sense, not just aesthetic sense. Argue why these two culinary worlds are compatible from the standpoint of shared aromatic profiles. Develop the complete recipe with ingredients from both cultures and mixed preparation techniques.

You are a chef specialized in high-end plant-based cooking. Create a vegan main course for a fine-dining restaurant using [MAIN VEGETABLE/LEGUME/MUSHROOM]. The dish must be satisfying, complex in flavor and visually striking. Include techniques to boost plant-based umami, protein substitutes and Michelin-star-level presentation.

Create a recipe for the [SEASON/MONTH] season using the best market products of that time of year. Also develop the story of the dish for the menu: a narrative of at most 80 words that evokes the origin of the ingredient, the local producer (fictional but believable) and the emotion the dish aims to convey to the guest.

Design a prix-fixe menu of [NUMBER] courses for a restaurant with an average check of [PRICE] per person. The target food cost is [%]. Provide the complete recipe for each dish with a basic cost card per portion, listing ingredient, quantity in grams and estimated cost per dish.

Create a series of 6 signature appetizers/snacks to open a menu at a [TYPE OF RESTAURANT]. They must be 1-inch bites (2-3 cm), served in a single mouthful and visually surprising. For each one: name, main ingredient, technique, serving temperature and a verbal description so the front-of-house team can present them correctly.

Develop the recipe for the mother sauce [SAUCE NAME: espagnole/velouté/béchamel/hollandaise/tomato] with its exact proportions and classic preparation technique. From it, generate 5 derivative sauces with their specific modifications. Include culinary applications for each derivative and recommended storage.

prompts.titulo: Creative Mise en Place for Service
prompts.cuerpo: I'm a head chef in a restaurant with [NUMBER] services per day. Design the complete mise en place to prepare the dish [DISH NAME] in record time during service. Organize it in order of anticipation: day-before preparations, morning preparations and à la minute tasks. Include estimated times and quality-control checkpoints.

A guest has the following dietary restrictions: [LIST: gluten-free/lactose-free/egg-free/vegan/nut-free]. Adapt the recipe for [ORIGINAL DISH] so it suits this profile without losing flavor, texture or presentation. Clearly state the substitutes used and how the preparation process changes.

Act as a culinary creative director. Based on the following conceptual inputs: color [COLOR], emotion [EMOTION], season [SEASON], childhood memory [MEMORY], develop a signature recipe that synthesizes all of these elements. Explain how each ingredient or technique represents each of the inputs given.

Act as an expert food & beverage controller. I need the complete recipe costing for the dish [DISH NAME]. For each ingredient state: gross quantity in grams, yield loss percentage by type of processing, resulting net quantity, cost per kg/unit and net cost per portion. At the end calculate the total food cost and the suggested selling price with a margin of [%].

I need the exact yield loss percentages for the following ingredients under the conditions I specify: [INGREDIENT 1] with process [PROCESS: peeling/filleting/deboning], [INGREDIENT 2] with process [PROCESS], [INGREDIENT 3] with process [PROCESS]. For each one state the standard yield loss percentage, the causes of variation and how to optimize yield.

I have a menu with an average food cost of [%] and I need to bring it down to [%] without lowering perceived quality. Analyze these dish categories: [APPETIZERS/MAIN COURSES/DESSERTS] with their current selling prices. Suggest which ingredients to substitute, which portions to adjust and which high-cost dishes could have more profitable alternative versions.

In my kitchen I generate the following by-products every week: [LIST OF BY-PRODUCTS: fish bones/peels/meat trimmings/etc.]. Design a complete utilization plan to turn each by-product into something of value: stocks, infused oils, crisps, powders, etc. Include a basic recipe and a menu application for each one.

Apply the menu engineering methodology (stars/plowhorses/puzzles/dogs matrix) to my current menu. I have these dishes with last month's sales data and cost: [LIST OF DISHES WITH SALES AND COST FOR EACH]. Classify each dish into its quadrant, explain the reasoning and recommend concrete actions for each category.

I'm the chef of a restaurant with [NUMBER] covers per day and [NUMBER] operating days per month. The average check is [PRICE] and the target food cost is [%]. Calculate the monthly raw materials budget and break it down by category: meats, fish, vegetables, dairy, beverages and other. Include a safety margin of [%] for unexpected costs.

Calculate the real profitability of these dishes on my menu, considering not only ingredient cost but also labor cost based on preparation time: [DISH 1: ingredients, prep time, selling price], [DISH 2], [DISH 3]. Include the real contribution margin and an optimal price recommendation.

Write the standardized recipe card for the dish [DISH NAME] so that any member of my team can prepare it identically. The card must include: a photo of the final plating (detailed description), ingredients with exact weights (grams or ounces) per portion and per 10 portions, numbered preparation process, serving temperature, plateware to use and updated cost.

Design an inventory control system for a [TYPE OF BUSINESS] kitchen with [NUMBER] employees. Include: product categories to inventory, recommended counting frequency, reorder thresholds for the 20 most-used products, a simplified log sheet and an alert protocol for when stock drops below the minimum. Practical format to print and use in the kitchen.

Act as a food & beverage purchasing advisor. I need to negotiate better terms with my [CATEGORY: meat/fish/fruit and vegetable/dairy] supplier. My monthly purchase volume is [QUANTITY/AMOUNT]. Write a negotiation pitch, the key points to negotiate (price, payment terms, exclusivity, volume discounts) and a professional email to open the negotiation.

My restaurant currently generates [KG/WEEK] of food waste. The main sources of waste are: [LIST]. Design a 3-phase waste reduction plan (30, 60, 90 days) with concrete actions, who is responsible for each action and tracking metrics. Include a calculation of the potential cost savings.

Help me review the pricing of my menu. My data: restaurant type [TYPE], location [CITY/AREA], direct competition with an average price of [PRICE], my labor costs represent [%] of revenue. Analyze these [NUMBER] dishes with their current costs and suggest the optimal selling price using these methodologies: cost multiplier, perceived value and market price.

Design the HACCP critical control points for the preparation process of [TYPE OF DISH/PREPARATION: carpaccio/tartare/desserts with raw egg/smoked items]. Include: hazards identified at each stage, critical limits, monitoring system, corrective actions and documented records. Simple, visual format for use in the kitchen.

I have next week's menu with these dishes: [LIST OF DISHES]. My estimated portions per day are: [MONDAY: 40, TUESDAY: 55...]. Generate the optimized supplier order list, grouped by category and supplier, with the exact quantities needed plus a [%] margin. Indicate what can be prepared in advance to optimize the cold chain.

Design a complete menu proposal for a wedding with [NUMBER] guests and a budget of [PRICE] per person. The style of the event is [STYLE: classic/bohemian/rustic/modern]. 20% of the guests have restrictions: [LIST]. Include: welcome cocktail, first course, second course, dessert and sweet table. With a client-facing presentation and cost breakdown.

prompts.titulo: Kitchen Logistics for a Large Event
prompts.cuerpo: I'm the chef in charge of a catering event for [NUMBER] guests. The agreed menu is [BRIEF DESCRIPTION]. The event is on [DATE] at [TYPE OF VENUE]. Create the complete production plan: prep schedule (D-3, D-2, D-1, event day by the hour), list of required equipment, recommended minimum crew and critical temperature and food safety points.

I need to prepare a detailed quote for a catering service: [EVENT DESCRIPTION]. Break it down by: raw material cost, staff (hours × role), equipment/tableware rental, transport/travel, disposables/presentation materials, profit margin of [%] and sales tax/VAT. Present the quote in a professional format to send to the client.

Design 3 menu proposals for a corporate event for [COMPANY/SECTOR] with [NUMBER] attendees. Guest profile: executives aged 35-55, a 2-hour working lunch. The proposals must be: BASIC (economical and efficient), MID (balance of quality and price) and PREMIUM (high-impact representation). Include the recommended setup for each option.

Design the welcome cocktail reception for a themed event based on [THEME: harvest/Mediterranean/70s/Spain around the world]. Include: 8-10 finger food pieces with short recipes, 2 signature non-alcoholic cocktails and 2 alcoholic ones related to the theme, presentation and decoration of the space consistent with the theme and recommended service timing.

I have a catering job for [NUMBER] people where [%] have a variety of dietary restrictions. Create the complete allergen management protocol for the event, based on the allergen rules that apply to you (US: the FDA's 9 major allergens · UK/EU: the 14 regulated allergens): identification of guests with restrictions, system of differentiated trays/plates, communication to the front-of-house team, labeling at the buffet and an emergency protocol if there is an allergic reaction.

Design the international breakfast/lunch/dinner buffet for a [CATEGORY] hotel with [NUMBER] rooms. The guest profile is: [DESCRIPTION]. Include a weekly rotation of the buffet items so that long-stay guests don't see repeats, considering: cultural variety, profitability per linear foot of display and rotation of the offering.

prompts.titulo: Food Truck for a Special Event
prompts.cuerpo: Design the complete culinary concept to take my food truck to the [TYPE OF EVENT: festival/fair/Christmas market/sporting event] event. The space is [SQUARE FEET] and the expected attendance is [NUMBER] people over [HOURS]. Include: a reduced, executable menu (4-6 products), selling price, estimated cost, required equipment and a visibility strategy at the event.

Design the menu for the company holiday dinner/lunch for [NUMBER] people with a budget of [PRICE] per person. The venue is [DESCRIPTION]. The menu must have a festive spirit without being excessively expensive. Include an alcohol-free option for each course, an adaptation for the [%] of the group who are vegetarian and a matching table decoration proposal.

Generate the complete operational checklist for the day of a [TYPE] catering event. Organized by phases: 4 hours before, 2 hours before, 1 hour before, 30 minutes before, during service and close-down/breakdown. Include: food temperature control, space layout, confirmation of quantities, staff readiness and backup equipment.

Analyze the profitability of my last 3 catering events: [EVENT 1: type, guests, revenue, actual costs], [EVENT 2], [EVENT 3]. Calculate the net margin of each, identify where costs deviated from the original budget and provide 5 concrete recommendations to improve profitability on similar future events.

Design the wine selection for a [TYPE] event with menu [DESCRIPTION]. Budget per bottle: between [MINIMUM PRICE] and [MAXIMUM PRICE]. Include: 2 whites, 2 reds, 1 rosé and 1 sparkling wine for the toast. For each wine state: appellation of origin, grape variety, specific pairing with the dish on the menu and approximate cost price.

prompts.titulo: Complaints and Returns Protocol for Catering
prompts.cuerpo: Write the professional incident management protocol for catering services. Include the procedure for: a dish that arrives cold, cross-contamination detected at an event, a shortage in the quantity of product, a complaint about the quality of a specific dish, a client dissatisfied with the overall presentation. For each case: immediate response, solution, follow-up and compensation.

Write a professional sales proposal for the catering service for [EVENT: type, date, guests]. The proposal must include: introduction of the service, detailed menu, terms of service, staff included, cancellation policy, payment method and differentiators from the competition. Formal but warm style, aimed at closing the sale.

prompts.titulo: Instagram Post for a Signature Dish
prompts.cuerpo: Act as a food & beverage copywriter specialized in social media. Write the Instagram post to present [DISH NAME] from my restaurant. Communication style: [TONE: elegant/casual/emotional/technical]. Include: 3 versions of the caption (short 50 words, medium 100 words, long 200 words), 15 hashtags segmented by reach and the text for the introductory Stories.

Create the social media content calendar for [BUSINESS NAME] for the month of [MONTH/YEAR]. Type of business: [DESCRIPTION]. Include: date, platform (Instagram/Facebook/TikTok/Pinterest), content type (reels/carousel/photo/stories), post topic, call to action and goal (engagement/sales/branding/education). Table format for 30 days.

prompts.titulo: SEO Description for a Dish on the Website
prompts.cuerpo: Write the SEO-optimized description of the dish [DISH NAME] for my restaurant's website. City where the restaurant is located: [CITY]. Include: SEO title (55-60 characters), meta description (150-160 characters), long description of the dish for the website (200 words), secondary keywords to use naturally and a call to action to book.

prompts.titulo: Professional Reply to a Negative Review
prompts.cuerpo: Act as a restaurant communications director. A guest left this negative review on Google: [REVIEW TEXT]. Write 3 versions of a reply: one empathetic and apologetic, one that explains the context without making excuses, and one that turns the complaint into a visible opportunity for improvement. All must be professional, non-defensive and aimed at winning the guest back.

Write the complete script for a 60-second Instagram Reel showing the preparation of [DISH NAME]. Include: scenes with a visual description, on-screen text for each scene, suggested music by genre, a final call to action and the post caption. The style must be [STYLE: professional/fun/educational/emotional] and aimed at [GOAL].

Write the monthly newsletter for the guests of [RESTAURANT NAME]. In this issue include: a new menu item for [MONTH], an upcoming special event [EVENT], the story of the chef/team (humanization), a featured seasonal product and an exclusive offer for subscribers. Warm style, like a personal letter from foodie friends. Length: 400-500 words.

Design the complete communication strategy for the launch of the new seasonal menu at [RESTAURANT NAME]. Include a 4-week plan: teaser week, reveal week, official launch week and consolidation week. For each week: social media actions, press communication, email marketing and in-house activations.

Write the professional bio of chef [NAME] for: Instagram profile (150 characters), restaurant website (200 words), press release (400 words) and LinkedIn (300 words). Their details are: [EXPERIENCE, TRAINING, CUISINE, ACHIEVEMENTS, PHILOSOPHY]. Each version adapted to the corresponding channel and tone.

Create 10 pin ideas for the [TOPIC: easy recipes/cooking techniques/world dishes/baking] board of my food Pinterest profile. For each pin state: title (max 100 characters), description (max 500 characters), relevant keywords for Pinterest SEO and the ideal type of image to go with it. Optimized for search on Pinterest.

prompts.titulo: Email Campaign for a Special Event
prompts.cuerpo: Design a 3-phase email campaign to promote [EVENT: special dinner/themed night/launch of a new space] on [DATE]. Email 1 (teaser, 2 weeks before), Email 2 (main invitation, 1 week before), Email 3 (last call + urgency, 2 days before). For each email: subject line, preheader, body copy and CTA. Tone: [TONE].

Develop the complete hashtag strategy for a [TYPE OF RESTAURANT] located in [CITY]. Create 4 groups of hashtags: mega hashtags (1M+ posts), large hashtags (100K-1M), medium (10K-100K) and niche (<10K). Also include geotagged hashtags for [CITY] and [NEIGHBORHOOD/AREA]. A total of 60 hashtags organized and ready to use in rotation.

prompts.titulo: Menu Presentation Script for Front of House
prompts.cuerpo: Create the verbal script that the front-of-house staff will use to present the dishes of the new menu to guests. For each of these dishes: [LIST OF DISHES], write a 20-30 second oral presentation that highlights: the main ingredient and its origin, the main cooking technique, the flavor/texture the guest will experience. Evocative language but not pretentious.

Design the collaboration plan with food influencers for [RESTAURANT NAME]. Include: ideal influencer profile (followers, engagement, niche), briefing for the visit (what to show, what key messages to communicate), collaboration terms (compensation, minimum content, publishing timing) and success metrics for the collaboration.

Optimize the Google Business Profile presence of [RESTAURANT NAME] in [CITY]. Generate: business description (750 characters, SEO-optimized with local keywords), standard replies to the 5 most common guest questions, 3 Google Posts for next month and a review management protocol (positive and negative) with reply templates.

Act as the executive pastry chef of a fine-dining restaurant. Design a menu dessert for [SEASON] with [STAR INGREDIENT] as the protagonist. The dessert must have at least 3 distinct components (creamy texture, crunchy element and sauce/coulis). Include: dessert name, conceptual story, detailed mise en place, preparation of each component, plating and a pairing with dessert wine or coffee.

Design the recipe for a signature artisan bread with [DIFFERENTIATING INGREDIENT: sourdough/ancient grains/special seeds/infusions]. Hydration percentage: [%]. Include: complete baker's formula with percentages, fermentation process (times, temperatures, stages), shaping technique, scoring and baking. Explain the impact of each variable on the final result.

Develop the complete recipe for a [TYPE: molded/dipped/truffle] chocolate bonbon with a [FLAVOR/INGREDIENT] filling. Include: tempering the chocolate (temperature curve by type: dark/milk/white), ganache or filling recipe with exact weights (grams or ounces), step-by-step process, decoration and storage. Calculate the approximate cost per unit.

Design the complete recipe for a [TYPE: birthday/wedding/anniversary] celebration cake with [BASE FLAVOR] and [THEMED DECORATION]. For [NUMBER] servings. Include: sponge, soaking syrup, filling cream, covering cream, tier-by-tier assembly technique, finish and decoration. With temperature specifications for each component and shelf-life times.

prompts.titulo: Croissant and Viennoiserie for Fine Pastry
prompts.cuerpo: Give me the professional recipe for the classic croissant with laminated dough. Weights for [NUMBER] units. Include: complete détrempe formula, lamination process (number of turns, resting times, temperature of the butter block), shaping, final proof and baking. Then adapt the same base dough to create 3 different viennoiseries.

prompts.titulo: Artisan Ice Cream with a Complex Flavor
prompts.cuerpo: Design the recipe for a high-end artisan ice cream with a [COMPLEX FLAVOR: curry-mango/cheese-fig/coffee-cardamom] flavor. Include: ice cream base mix (custard or sorbet type), weights of each component, required stabilizers and emulsifiers with exact doses, pasteurization, aging and churning process. Target texture and ideal serving temperature.

Act as a chocolatier and sommelier specialized in cacao. Design a pairing of 5 bonbons or chocolate bars with 5 different beverages [CATEGORY: wines/whiskies/craft beers/spirits]. For each pair: origin and percentage of the cacao, sensory characteristics of the chocolate, chosen beverage with its notes and an explanation of why they work together.

Design the complete dessert menu for a [TYPE] restaurant with [NUMBER] items. It must include: 1 refreshing citrus dessert, 1 chocolate dessert, 1 seasonal fruit dessert, 1 dairy-based dessert, 1 tartlet/pastry piece and 1 reinterpreted nostalgic dessert. For each one: name, menu description (40 words) and suggested price.

Guide me through creating and maintaining a [TYPE: wheat/rye/spelt] sourdough starter from scratch. A 14-day plan: what to do each day (proportions of flour, water and temperature), health indicators of the starter at each stage, how to know when it is ready to use and a weekly maintenance protocol once it is established. With a daily tracking table.

prompts.titulo: Pastry Shop Window Display for a Season
prompts.cuerpo: Design the pastry shop window display proposal for [SEASON: Christmas/Valentine's Day/Easter/Halloween/summer]. Include: 6-8 star seasonal products with description, suggested selling price and estimated cost, visual layout of the window, recommended packaging, communication message and social media actions to promote each piece.

Develop the complete process for making a bean-to-bar chocolate bar with cacao of [ORIGIN] origin. From cacao processing: roasting (temperature and time), winnowing, grinding, conching, tempering and molding. Include the variables that determine the final flavor profile and how to adjust them to achieve [DESIRED PROFILE: fruity/earthy/floral/spiced].

Help me calculate the fair price for a custom cake with this data: [FLAVORS AND FILLINGS], [NUMBER] tiers, decoration [DESCRIPTION], for [NUMBER] people, delivery to [CITY]. Break down: materials cost, preparation time (hours × hourly rate of [PRICE]), packaging cost, profit margin and final price to the client. Justification of the price.

Create the recipe for an Italian artisan gelato of [FLAVOR] with authentic texture. Key differences from American ice cream: lower fat percentage, higher density, less air incorporation (overrun). Include: ingredients with exact weights (grams or ounces), base mix, pasteurization process, aging (at least 4 hours at 39°F (4°C)), churning and storage and serving temperature.

Guide me through making the following chocolate decorations for fine pastry: [TECHNIQUE 1: transfer sheets/spray/shavings/molded figures]. For each technique: ideal type of chocolate, working temperature, necessary tools, step-by-step process and common mistakes. Also include how to combine these decorations in the final presentation of a restaurant dessert.

Act as a specialist in molecular food pairing. I need to find the best ingredients to pair with [MAIN INGREDIENT]. Analyze the shared aromatic compounds and suggest: 3 classic, well-known pairings, 3 surprising but scientifically sound pairings, and 3 avant-garde pairings for innovation. For each one explain the molecular reason why.

prompts.titulo: Wine and Dish Pairing for the Menu
prompts.cuerpo: Design the wine and dish pairing selection for my restaurant's menu. The dishes are: [LIST OF DISHES]. For each dish suggest: a white wine option, a red wine option, an alternative option (sparkling/rosé/fortified) and a non-alcoholic drink for non-drinkers. Include the reasoning behind the pairing in accessible language so the front-of-house staff can explain it.

Create a craft beer and food pairing guide for [TYPE OF RESTAURANT/BAR]. For each beer style: [AMBER ALE, IPA, STOUT, SAISON, CRAFT LAGER], state the best dishes it pairs with, the aromatic/flavor reason why and how to present it on the menu. Also include serving temperature and ideal glass type.

For the following tasting menu of [NUMBER] courses: [DESCRIPTION OF EACH DISH], design the complete beverage pairing. Option 1: classic pairing with wines. Option 2: alternative pairing with craft beers, kombuchas and spirits. For each beverage: name, reason for the pairing and serving temperature. Total beverages for the full menu.

Design a cheese board for [RESTAURANT/BAR] with 5-7 domestic and international varieties. For each cheese state: name, origin, type of milk, aging, sensory characteristics, the best accompaniment (jam, nuts, bread) and the ideal beverage pairing. Also create the menu description so the team can present it.
